closes.text: a `self.note()` inside a trait default was recorded as a dispatch with no receiver, and the refinement kept every implementation as its target. Now the default's `Self` is resolved at each ENTRY of the default, as a bounded parameter is: from a concrete receiver, from a bounded receiver (followed to the bounded generic's own calls through any number of forwarders), from another default's `self` call, or from `self` handed to a bounded generic; leaving a default through a dispatch keeps only the types for which that dispatch runs the default (an override in between drops out). THE FALLBACK STAYS for an entry with no receiver on record (a call through a `dyn` object), a function taken as a value, a dispatch outside the listed sites and an opaque binding: each still charges every candidate. Sound because a type is dropped only when the record says it selects something else. Pins in `inference::contexts`, each red with the old behaviour planted: the repro and its one-level form, three levels of forwarding, a default calling a default, a default handing `self` to a bounded generic, a generic struct's method forwarding to a default, the override between two defaults, a top-level entry; eight bodies still refused where the strict impl is really reached without the context, plus the `dyn` case; four `native_differential` pins build and run the newly accepted programs on both backends. TWO OLDER PINS CHANGED VERDICT ON PURPOSE (their conservative refusals were false): `contexts::a_receiverless_dispatch_keeps_every_member_it_may_select` is now `..._resolves_by_its_defaults_self`, and `styling::a_shared_default_self_call_refuses_conservatively_even_for_a_clean_receiver` is now `..._resolves_by_its_receiver` (its own comment asked for the revisit). the walk that places a refusal, and its trace, now follow the refined dispatch edges the check itself reads (`RefinedEdge::through` carries the calls an edge crosses), instead of the wide, name-keyed ones. On the repro: 1 error whose trace named all three `shown(..)` calls is now 1 error naming only `shown(cell)`; with the generic in a package, a forwarding generic in a package and a trait default in a package: 3 errors each became 1, at the call that causes it. Pins `macros::b741_*` (count and site) and `contexts::b741_*` (exact traces), each red against the old walk. No diagnostic text changed.
